# Meta-Analysis {#sec-ch-15-metaanalysis}

<!-- page-provenance:start -->
::: {.page-provenance}
*R. Heller · Date: 2026-05-11 · Last changed: 2026-10-30*
:::
<!-- page-provenance:end -->

Pairwise random- and fixed-effects meta-analysis, network meta-analysis, individual-patient-data meta-analysis, and PRISMA-aligned reporting. Heterogeneity is treated as the main result, not a nuisance.

This chapter contains **25 method pages** and **3 labs**. If you are not sure which method to read, return to [Chapter 0](#sec-find-your-method) and follow the decision tree to the right node.
